articles.title: NASA’s Chandra Unveils Mysterious X-Ray Objects
articles.summary: Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory, scientists have discovered a new class of objects behaving unlike any they have seen before. Astronomers suggest these newly spotted objects in other galaxies may help solve not one, but two long-standing questions in astrophysics.
